scope: The private patios behind the Elena north garden wall, between the hedged beds and the east terrace (registry 6265401UF1366N_part3), where they meet Cervantes. Only the enclosure walls and the pergola beam that ground photos show are built; the patios' internal partitions, floors and levels are not visible in any photo and are not modelled.
trust: The roof shots listed for the task (IMG_2366, IMG_2360) look along Cervantes east of the junction: their paved strip, trained-trunk white wall, curved-coping door and cane-roofed pergola are on the Cervantes side (compare IMG_2197). From every roof camera the patios behind the garden wall are under the magnolia canopy (IMG_2362, IMG_2364). The enclosure walls and pergola here come from ground photos; positions are anchored to the existing garden wall, hedged bed, Cervantes axis and registry face, about 0.5-1 m in plan. Heights and the pergola's extent are estimated.

review.trust: The patio band between the garden wall (west), the Cervantes wall (south) and the registry face of 6265401UF1366N_part3 (east). Generated garden walls, gates and props are suppressed inside it; nothing invented is drawn there.

walls.name: Elena east patios · garden wall behind the second hedged bed
walls.trust: IMG_2199 shows the white garden wall continuing south of the closed timber door with a bougainvillea trunk trained on it; IMG_2197, looking along Cervantes, shows the same wall behind the second hedged bed up to the lane frontage. Continues the existing elena-north-garden-wall line from its door surround and turns at the bed's Cervantes end. Height matches the existing garden wall (estimated).

walls.name: Elena east patios · white wall behind the plumbago bed on Cervantes
walls.trust: IMG_2356 shows a continuous white wall standing behind the raised plumbago bed on the north side of Cervantes east of Elena, with bougainvillea over it and no gate; IMG_2197 shows unbroken planting and white walls along that frontage. Drawn 2.0 m north of the Cervantes axis, behind the existing kerb and hedge, from the garden wall corner to the registry face of 6265401UF1366N_part3, where the house front takes over. Line and height estimated; no opening is photographed, so it is solid.

pergola.name: Elena east patios · timber pergola behind the garden door
pergola.trust: A dark timber pergola beam shows above the garden wall just north of the closed door in IMG_2199, and again over the wall near the door in IMG_2200, with bougainvillea on it. Only that edge is visible: the 2.7 x 2.5 m extent, the four posts, rafters and 2.35 m height are estimates. It stands inside the walled patio, out of reach of the player.
